agent_id.description: URL-safe slug, unique per agent. Also the folder name under records/agents/.

job.description: One sentence: the job this agent owns. One job, not a department.

owns.description: The concrete steps of that job this agent performs end to end.

reads.description: Paths or named sources the agent is allowed to read. Anything not listed is out of scope.

writes.description: The single directory this agent writes into. One agent, one output location.

voice_source.description: Path to the file that fixes its voice, normally records/brands/<brand_id>/project-knowledge.md.

allowed_tools.description: The allowlist. Tool or command names the agent may use. Empty means it may do nothing, so it is never empty.

forbidden.description: Named actions this agent must refuse even when asked directly.

escalate_when.description: The exceptions that stop the agent and come to the human. At least one, or it is not an agent, it is a script.

required.description: True when an action of this agent needs a human keystroke before it runs.

trigger.description: What trips the gate: spending money, sending outside, publishing, deleting. 'none' only when the agent writes nothing but local drafts.

acceptance.description: At least two checks a human can run against a finished output to say pass or fail. No vibes.
